Omdienepag is a relatively selective EP2 receptor agonist which decreases intraocular pressure (IOP). The exact mechanism of action is unknown at this time.

modality.text: Small molecule (topical ophthalmic prostaglandin EP2 receptor agonist, administered as an isopropyl-ester prodrug)

citations.quote: Omlonti (omidenepag isopropyl ophthalmic solution) 0.002%, contains the prodrug form of the active omdienepag, a relatively selective prostaglandin EP2 receptor agonist with ocular hypotensive activity. Omdienepag isopropyl is a white to light brown crystal or crystalline powder and practically insoluble in water.

key_safety.text: Data reflect exposure in 600 patients for up to 3 months. Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥1%): conjunctival hyperemia (9%), photophobia (5%), vision blurred (4%), dry eye (3%), instillation site pain (3%), eye pain (2%), ocular hyperemia (2%), punctate keratitis (2%), headache (2%), eye irritation (1%), and visual impairment (1%).

citations.quote: The data described below reflect exposure to Omlonti in 600 patients for up to 3 months.
